usage: tunnel recordings [-h] [--base BASE] [--json]
                         {ls,show,export,import,rm} ...

positional arguments:
  {ls,show,export,import,rm}
    ls                  one row per recorded call
    show                one recorded call in full
    export              write the recordings out as a directory to commit
    import              read a directory of recordings back into the server
    rm                  delete recordings

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           where the admin API answers (default
                        http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json                print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
